biggest_catch: Each referral requires the friend to register via your referral link and complete a qualifying action within 90 days - checking track: 500+ USD in direct deposits plus eStatements and good standing; credit-card track: open an eligible card. A friend can complete both tracks, paying you up to 200 USD. Rewards are Visa Reward Cards (not cash); cap 500 USD per calendar year.
catches: Friend must register for the referral offer using your personal referral link (or register via the email/social invite).

Personal Checking Account track: friend becomes a Blue FCU member, opens an eligible checking account (NOVA Perks Elite, NOVA Perks Premium, or Basic checking) and within 90 days completes one or more direct deposits of $500 or more each, enrolls in eStatements, and keeps the account in good standing.
Credit Card track: friend becomes a Blue FCU member and opens a new eligible credit card (Pathways, Everyday Rewards, Cash Back, or Business Rewards) within 90 days of joining.
Reward is a $100 Visa Reward Card per qualifying referral (not cash); 'up to $200' means $100 for checking + $100 for the credit card if the same friend completes both.
Cap: up to $500 per calendar year per referrer.
Allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all offer requirements.

steps: Register for the referral program on bluefcu.com/refer/ and provide your information.
Invite your friends and family by providing their contact information and a valid email, or share the offer via social media.

Friend registers via your referral link, becomes a Blue FCU member, and opens an eligible checking account (completing the $500+ direct deposit, eStatement, good-standing requirements within 90 days) or opens a new eligible credit card within 90 days of joining.
You receive a $100 Visa Reward Card per qualifying referral, delivered 4-6 weeks after requirements are completed.
timing: Allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all offer requirements.
when_cash_arrives: Allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all offer requirements. The payout clock starts when your friend finishes qualifying, and the reward arrives as a mailed (or emailed) Reward Card 4-6 weeks later.
maximize: Start the clock ASAP: the 4-6-week card window only begins after your friend completes every requirement - have them qualify in the first days of the window, not the last.
Front-load the friend's activity (debit transactions, direct deposit) so verification does not push delivery past 6 weeks.
Watch for a redemption email - some ReferLive programs issue virtual cards faster than physical mail.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: payout is a Reward Card with a 4-6-week delivery window baked into the terms - qualification speed is the only lever.
